subject.title: Feature: Cross-platform multi-select component in message tool

question: Should portable message presentation gain a batch-select block with typed selected-values output, and what fallback should channels without native multi-select use?
rationale: The current public SDK contract is scalar and the target channels have materially different native capabilities, so implementation cannot safely choose the permanent result and degradation semantics without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add portable batch select
options.body: Introduce an additive block with min/max cardinality, array-valued results, native rendering where available, and an explicit text fallback.

options.title: Keep channel-specific
options.body: Leave rich multi-select flows to channel plugins and document numbered-text replies as the portable workflow.

recommendation.title: Add portable batch select
recommendation.body: Introduce an additive block with min/max cardinality, array-valued results, native rendering where available, and an explicit text fallback.
